evidence.quote: In this paper, we introduce a novel method, namely Rotary Position Embedding(RoPE), to leverage the positional information into the learning process of PLMS. Specifically, RoPE encodes the absolute position with a rotation matrix and meanwhile incorporates the explicit relative position dependency in self-attention formulation.

Our theoretical analysis indicates that relative position can be naturally formulated using vector production in self-attention, with absolution position information being encoded through a rotation matrix.

In contrast to the additive nature of position embedding method adopted in the previous works, i.e., Equations (3) to (10), our approach is multiplicative.
